english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physically closing and reopening your eyes quickly.
Use this for blinking or fluttering the eyelashes, especially in the phrase 眨眼.

examples.english: I blink whenever I get nervous.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 gan2 zoeng1 zau6 wui5 zaam2 ngaan5

examples.english: I saw her bat her eyes at me.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gin3 dou2 keoi5 hoeng3 ngo5 zaam2 ngaan5
